title: Unravelling the role of nanoparticle morphology during uptake and transport in eggplants
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00920K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lifei Xi, Yamin Wang, Alfiz Muhammad Qizwini, Yee Yan Tay, Chris Boothroyd, Yeng Ming Lam
Gold nanocarriers with distinct shapes penetrate eggplant leaves, redistribute through vascular tissues, and undergo morphology-dependent transformation, providing insights into nanoparticle uptake and targeted delivery in plants.
